final: SELECT b.event_status AS status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_left_over, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) - overall.average_left_over AS difference_from_overall FROM budget AS b CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over FROM budget) AS overall WHERE overall.average_left_over IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.event_status
